terms.

The rules for using Raisin, in plain words. This page is also the app’s end user license agreement (EULA).

Effective September 25, 2026

The short version

  • You must be 18 or older to use Raisin.
  • Raisin is education and training. It is not medical care, and it does not diagnose or treat anything.
  • The coach is an AI. It can be wrong. Use it for coaching, not for explicit content, and report replies that seem off.
  • See a doctor for anything that could be medical. In an emergency, call 911.
  • Raisin Pro renews automatically through Apple until you cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before it renews. Apple handles refunds.
  • These terms are governed by California law.

The full terms below are what count.

1. The agreement

These Terms of Use are an agreement between you and Anish Polakala (“Raisin”, “we”, “us”), the developer of the Raisin iPhone app and this website. By downloading or using Raisin you agree to these terms and to our privacy policy. If you do not agree, do not use Raisin.

These terms are the end user license agreement for the app. Where they differ from Apple’s standard EULA, these terms apply between you and us.

2. Who can use Raisin

You must be at least 18 years old. Raisin discusses sex and sexual health throughout, and it is rated 18+ on the App Store. When you first open the app, you confirm your age. Where Apple provides a declared age range for your account and it is under 18, the app will not run.

Do not use Raisin if you are under 18, and do not give it to anyone who is. You must also be able to form a binding contract where you live.

3. What Raisin is, and is not

Raisin provides educational content and behavioral coaching for sexual wellbeing: programs, timed exercises, check-ins and an AI coach.

Raisin is not a medical device. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it is not a substitute for care from a doctor, urologist, sex therapist or other licensed professional. Nothing in Raisin creates a doctor-patient or therapist-client relationship.

The check-ins and assessments are adapted from screening tools. A score is not a diagnosis. Erection and ejaculation difficulties can have physical causes. If your symptoms are persistent, painful, sudden or worrying, or before any decision about medication or treatment, talk to a clinician. Never delay seeking care because of something you read in Raisin.

Results vary. The exercises are drawn from published research; many men improve, some do not, and some conditions need medical treatment. We make no promise about outcomes.

4. Emergencies

Raisin is not for emergencies, and nobody monitors it in real time.

If you have an erection lasting more than four hours, chest pain during or after sex, an injury, or bleeding, get urgent care now. If you are thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 in the US, or call 911 or your local emergency number. More on the safety page.

5. No account: your device is your key

Raisin does not have accounts. The app creates a random ID on your phone, and that is how we recognize you. Keep your phone secure: anyone with access to your unlocked phone can see your progress. App lock in Settings adds Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode in front of the app.

If you delete the app or delete your data, your progress is gone and cannot be restored. A subscription can be restored through Apple.

6. Your license to use Raisin

We grant you a personal, limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to install and use Raisin on Apple devices you own or control, as the App Store’s usage rules allow.

You may not copy, modify, sell, rent, lend, distribute, reverse-engineer or extract the app, its content or its prompts, or use any of them to build a competing product. All rights we do not expressly grant stay with us.

7. Your content

What you enter in Raisin, such as answers, check-ins, logs and coach messages, stays yours. You give us permission to store and process it to run Raisin for you, as the privacy policy describes. We do not use it for marketing or to train AI models.

You are responsible for what you type into the coach. Do not include anyone else’s private information.

8. Acceptable use

Do not:

  • use Raisin if you are under 18, or let anyone under 18 use it;
  • use it for anything illegal;
  • try to make the coach produce sexually explicit, erotic or fetish content, or any content involving minors;
  • harass, threaten or abuse anyone, including through the coach;
  • use it to plan anything non-consensual, or to manipulate or pressure another person;
  • probe, scrape, overload, interfere with or reverse-engineer the service, or try to extract our prompts or the model’s instructions;
  • share, resell or automate access to Raisin;
  • misrepresent your age or identity.

We may limit, suspend or end your access if you break these rules.

9. Ask Raisin, the AI coach

Ask Raisin is an automated assistant built on a large language model from Anthropic. It is not a person, a therapist or a doctor. It is available to Pro subscribers, it is off until you turn it on, and before it runs you consent to your messages being sent to Anthropic, as the privacy policy explains.

The coach can be wrong. Its replies are educational coaching generated in the moment, and they can be inaccurate, incomplete or off-tone. Do not rely on them for medical decisions.

The coach is designed to decline explicit content, medication or dosage questions, diagnoses and anything involving minors, and to point you to a doctor or a crisis line when your message calls for it. Before first use you agree to the coach content policy.

Every reply has a Report control. A person reviews reports within 24 hours and acts on them: we may correct the coach’s behavior, remove content, or suspend the coach for someone who abuses it. Message limits apply to keep the service reliable, and we may change them.

10. Raisin Pro subscriptions

Raisin Pro unlocks all programs, all guided drills and Ask Raisin. There are two plans:

  • Raisin Pro Yearly: $59.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.
  • Raisin Pro Monthly: $14.99 per month.

Prices are in US dollars and are shown in the app before you buy. Apple charges any applicable tax.

How billing works

  • Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends.
  • The subscription renews automatically for the same period at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • The free trial converts to a paid yearly subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. One free trial per Apple Account. Any unused part of a trial is forfeited if you buy a subscription during it.
  • Manage or cancel in your iPhone’s Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel. When you cancel, you keep Pro until the end of the period you have paid for.
  • Refunds are handled by Apple under the App Store terms. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds ourselves.
  • If we change a price, Apple will notify you in advance and you can cancel before the new price applies.
  • To restore a purchase on a new phone or after reinstalling, open Settings → Subscription → Restore purchases while signed in with the Apple Account you subscribed with.

11. The free part

Some sessions and drills are free without a subscription. We may change what is free, add or remove features, or stop offering Raisin. If we stop for good, we will give reasonable notice where we can, and Apple’s refund rules apply to any period you have paid for.
